international_evidence.fact: AUC operates under a 1975 protocol with the Egyptian government based on a 1962 Egypt-US cultural relations agreement, is incorporated in Delaware, and is licensed to grant degrees in the United States.

notes: AUC is included because its international institutional status is substantive and independently evidenced by a recognized US institutional accreditor plus the institution's Egypt-US legal/accreditation framework; it is not included merely because of an international partnership or its name.
